trend_rule: reliable = Mann-Kendall p < 0.05; slope is ordinary least squares per decade

trends.label: Longest run of days with < 1 mm, April–September

year_type_method.variable: April–September precipitation minus reference ET (gridMET), mm

grace.unit: cm liquid water equivalent, anomaly relative to the 2004–2009 mean
grace.note: Regional signal (~300 km mascon): groundwater + soil water + surface water. Never a field value. The p-value ignores month-to-month autocorrelation and is therefore optimistic.

smap.unit: m3/m3, root zone (0–100 cm), SMAP L4 9 km
smap.note: One 9 km model-assimilated cell, about 11 years of record: use the percentile and anomalies, not the absolute value, and do not read it as a field measurement.

caveats: Gridded weather is 4 km (gridMET) to about 50 km (NASA POWER): it describes the area, not the field.
NASA POWER precipitation is not used for trends; see precip_crosscheck.
GRACE is a regional value (~300 km). SMAP is a 9 km model-assimilated product.
